## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector signal (Energy, Consumer Staples, Financials positive vs Technology and Industrials negative) and notable multi-cap divergence (several large caps showing 1W/1M conflict), Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5), Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.92% | 1M: +30.67%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +24.90%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples/Payments also strong: PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology is weakest: LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND. Industrials show strain: CAT (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -9.42%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5) — dispersion across Financials, Healthcare, Consumer, Staples, Energy.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -9.42%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and select Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND. Note ACN in RECOVERY (1W: +4.48% | 1M: -6.11%) and PFE in RECOVERY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -4.51%) — short-term follow-through needed; major divergence present across large caps (META, JNJ, UNH, LLY) so treat momentum as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology is under pressure (sector 1W: -2.74% | 24 stocks) with large-cap bifurcation: AAPL (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND versus NVDA (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND and heavy losers LRCX, QCOM, ORCL, AMAT, IBM BELOW TREND — overall directional risk for the group.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials modestly positive (sector 1W: +0.67% | 20 stocks) with JPM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND — internal resilience supports parts of the market even as other sectors lag.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed: ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND but ISRG (1W: -13.25% | 1M: -12.19%) BELOW TREND and LLY in CORRECTION/RECOVERY pattern (1W: -2.96% | 1M: +3.14%) — sector 1W: -0.42% vs 1M: +6.39%, watch earnings/FDA/legal headlines for directional cues.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective Energy and Payments/Staples exposure (MPC, V, PM, PYPL) and monitor large-cap Tech for confirmation before adding; reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech names and pressured Industrials (ORCL, LRCX, CAT). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — adopt selective positioning and wait for clearer regime confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through, MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND for Energy momentum. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND — watch for continued downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +10.77%) and Consumer Staples (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +2.96%) — monitor breadth in these groups. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -1.33%) and Industrials (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -1.29%) — watch for spillover into Financials if weakness widens.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim 1M positive momentum would keep downside risk elevated. AAPL (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND — loss of 1W gains would signal cooling in leadership. PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND — need follow-through next week to confirm durable rotation into payments/financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
GM (+70): news notes full-year outlook raised — cross-ref with price: not in today’s top/bottom summary but sector-level tailwind supports autos and suppliers; monitor earnings confirmations. LMT (+60): $10.5B logistics win — sentiment aligns with industrial upside; check industrials for follow-through. AMD (+55): price target bumps/Microsoft deal cited — watch tech supplier group for spillover (price action mixed across semis).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
ORCL (-50): potential $7B guarantee risk for AI data center — ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed by sharp price decline. NFLX (-50): headline on earnings weakness — NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. PFE (-55): international patent lawsuits — PFE (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -4.51%) RECOVERY, news is a divergence to watch for sustained weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. PYPL ABOVE TREND, ABT ABOVE TREND and MPC ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (META, JNJ, UNH, LLY in CORRECTION) and headline-driven weakness in ORCL/NFLX — monitor for trend breaks.
